name: lims-kalibrasi
description: LIMS Kalibrasi — runs api/ and web/ together. Each folder is still its own npm package.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix web run start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix api run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
